changes_vs_current: New topic. Raw average-position order over 6 people sources (YouGov popularity, YouGov fame, Statista liking, YouGov 2026 consideration, BMI shipments, Coffeeness search): Budweiser, Heineken, Coors Light, Bud Light, Corona, Modelo, Miller Lite, Guinness, Blue Moon, Busch, Michelob Ultra, Samuel Adams, Stella Artois, Miller High Life, Dos Equis, Corona Light, PBR, Busch Light, Natural Light, Heineken Light, Yuengling, Coors Banquet, Miller Genuine Draft, Michelob Light, Keystone Light. Gut check vs raw: 10 of 12 inside the top 12. Moves: (1) Bud Light #4 -> #1: #1 in Statista liking and usage (33%/29%), #2 in YouGov fame (95%), #1 in BMI shipments, still top-3 by Circana 2025 volume; its raw score is dragged only by YouGov popularity (#15, polarized after 2023 boycott). Budweiser, Coors Light shift down one. (2) Michelob Ultra #11 -> #8: Circana 2025 has it #1 in volume and #2 in dollars and YouGov names it the only top-10 beer improver; the raw score leans on 2018 shipments (#5) and a low YouGov liking score. Guinness, Blue Moon, Busch shift down one. (3) Stella Artois (#13) and PBR (#17) left below #12 despite gut check: YouGov popularity (#9/#16 of items), fame (#18/#14), BMI shipments (#14/#18) and Statista (#16/absent) all place them below the leading group. (4) Keystone Light (raw #25) replaces Michelob Light (raw #24, 20.2 vs 21.5): Michelob Light is a near-discontinued brand whose rank rests only on YouGov ratings, while Keystone Light was #12 in BMI shipments and has 72% fame. Pacifico considered but has no YouGov/Statista data (only the critic aggregator), so left out. Brand family calls: Bud Light and Budweiser separate ('bud' alias on Budweiser); 'coors' alias on Coors Light (Coors Banquet takes 'banquet'/'coors original'); 'miller' on Miller Lite (High Life takes 'high life'); 'michelob' on Michelob Ultra; Corona Extra merged into Corona, Corona Light separate.
confidence: medium. Top 8 (Bud Light, Budweiser, Coors Light, Heineken, Corona, Modelo, Miller Lite, Michelob Ultra) are backed by all or nearly all sources, but no direct 'favorite beer' poll with percentages was found, the only full volume ranking available was 2018 BMI shipments (current 2024-25 Circana brand tables are paywalled/Cloudflare-blocked), and YouGov liking scores favor imports/craft (Guinness, Samuel Adams) over the mass light lagers people drink most. Tail order (Corona Light, Heineken Light, MGD, Coors Banquet, Keystone Light) is soft.
